integrity: The proof is self-contained and uses exact interval geometry, fixed-mass identities, and monotonicity of affine-over-radius averages.
The supplementary verifier uses exact rational arithmetic on representative step functions and is not used as a substitute for the general proof.
No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp threshold is proved for the one-dimensional two-tower background and fixed perturbation mass; it is not claimed for arbitrary backgrounds or higher dimensions.
Above the threshold, the theorem proves failure of universal shape-invisibility by construction, not a classification of every exceptional pair.
Targeted literature searches did not locate the same exact threshold, but an uncatalogued equivalent statement cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp shape-invisibility threshold for one-dimensional centered maximal fibers
